svg.data-dc-input: dual feed, -24/-48 VDC, 3 A (TMC-3348S-2DC, ordering table)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: two internal supplies, AC or DC
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 50 C; -40 to 70 C for the TM-3348SH
svg.data-services: MEF CE 2.0; 802.1Q, 802.1ad; MPLS VPWS, VPLS, H-VPLS; L3VPN with VRF
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588v2 PTP, SyncE; BITS in/out on the SH version
svg.data-licensing: SFP+ ports 3 and 4 need an activation licence
svg.data-resiliency: sub-50 ms G.8032 R-APS, STP/RSTP/MSTP, FRR, H-VPLS dual homing, LAG, BFD, redundant power
svg.data-local: CON RS-232 ASCII console and ETH out-of-band Ethernet on RJ45
